name: Share sheet
description: Shares text, links and images with the system share sheet through SwiftUI ShareLink and a Transferable item type.
usage: For a link, use `ShareLink(item: url, subject: Text(...), message: Text(...))` directly. For app content, build a `SharedItem(title:text:url:)` and use `ShareItemButton(item:)`, which shares it with a preview title. Share a deep link (see deep-links) so recipients open the same screen.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify share-sheet` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
